performers.title: Performers
performers.subtitle: Celebrate the richness of Vietnamese performing arts with live music, dance, martial arts, and more. This year's lineup showcases both traditional heritage and contemporary Vietnamese culture.
performers.scheduleNote: Times are approximate and subject to change. Check back closer to the event for the final schedule.

foodVendors.title: Food Vendors
foodVendors.subtitle: Explore the diverse flavours of Vietnamese cuisine at our festival. From street food classics to regional specialties, our vendors bring the best of Vietnam to Montreal.
foodVendors.becomeVendorDesc: We welcome food vendors who want to share authentic Vietnamese cuisine with the Montreal community. Applications open several months before the festival. Submit your interest and our team will get back to you with details.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have a question? Find answers to common inquiries below.

questions.question: When and where is the festival?
questions.answer: The Vietnamese Festival of Montreal takes place annually in the summer. Check our contact page for the latest dates and location details.

questions.question: Is there an admission fee?
questions.answer: General admission is free. Some ticketed events or shows may require a separate ticket purchase.

questions.question: Is the festival family-friendly?
questions.answer: Absolutely! The festival welcomes people of all ages with activities, food, and performances suited for the whole family.

questions.question: Can I volunteer at the festival?
questions.answer: Yes! We welcome volunteers. Please reach out through our contact page to learn about volunteer opportunities.

questions.question: Is parking available on-site?
questions.answer: Parking availability depends on the venue. We recommend using public transit or nearby paid parking lots.

questions.question: Are pets allowed?
questions.answer: For the safety and comfort of all attendees, pets are not permitted at the festival grounds unless they are certified service animals.

questions.question: How can I become a food vendor?
questions.answer: Vendors interested in participating can apply through our Food Vendors page. Applications open several months before the event.

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted at vendor booths?
questions.answer: Payment methods vary by vendor. We encourage vendors to accept both cash and card, but please carry some cash as a backup.

specialThanks.title: Special Thanks
specialThanks.subtitle: This festival would not be possible without the generous support of our sponsors, partners, and dedicated volunteers. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who made this celebration possible.
specialThanks.gratitudeText: We also thank the City of Montreal, the Vietnamese community organizations, and every attendee who joins us in celebrating Vietnamese culture and heritage. Your presence makes this festival a success year after year.
